notes: CPU-only PC (8 GB RAM) local models, PLUS one hosted free open-weight model on OpenRouter (zone public-api). Same local entries as config/local-models.cpu.json (that file is unchanged and still used by mode ollama-cpu-8gb). Used by test-console/modes/ollama-cpu-8gb-hosted.json, which starts the gateway with --auto-zones local --phi-zones local: chainaim/auto never picks the hosted model and health data never goes to it; it is used only when a client names it (console model list, or --model / -Model in the scripts). Only masked text reaches it. The key is read from OPENROUTER_API_KEY (asked at a hidden prompt by switch-models.ps1, never written to a file). The hosted model's context and output are taken as written: reasoning models spend output tokens on thinking. Check availability first: npm run verify:openrouter.
